# Reference shader

`glass.frag` here is an **unmodified copy** of the shader shipped by the Liquid Glass GNOME Shell extension.
It is the look everything in glass-lib has to reproduce.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | `~/Projects/GitHub/liquid-glass/liquid-glass@thinkingcoding1231.gmail.com/shaders/glass.frag` |
| Commit | `1029e76` (2026-09-27, "Match the lens and the edge to macOS 27 measurements"; the previous copy was `ca4cff4`) |
| SHA-256 | `9a15260f0aa704b74fe6da79cb9d90cd0410699b6c8e2d96230b060ea75e4991` |

**Do not edit this file.** It is a Cogl snippet. It runs outside Cogl through `../targets/compat/cogl_prelude.glsl`. It is used by:

- the S1 spike (`spikes/s1-full-renderer`), which draws in-app glass with it directly;
- the golden-image harness (S5, planned), which checks the extracted shader core against it (design §10.5).

To pick up a newer version, copy it again, then update the commit and hash above in the same change.
